comment: Fixed Masumi vested_pay V2 deployments for the devnet. cardano:preview has no canonical deployment, so payments carry extra.deployment and the allowlisted hash is rendered into NETWORKS_FILE before the facilitators start. Admin vkeys are 28-byte key hashes. Hashes derive from MasumiBlueprint.escrowScriptHash and agree with @x402/cardano 2.26.0 masumiEscrowScriptHash; MasumiTransferE2ETest re-derives and compares them.
